title: Historical ChEMBL DTI benchmark audit code and reproducibility workflow
description: Version 1.1.0 code-source view and provenance for the historical ChEMBL audit. Original project code is MIT; included ChEMBL-derived data retain CC BY-SA 3.0. The complete execution package with large expected data is a GitHub release asset and is archived separately at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24390323 . Raw SQLite/tar.gz and manuscript DOCX are excluded. The certified scope is the existing core graph/candidate/label/mechanism implementation on macOS arm64. No new scientific analysis, model training or independent implementation.
